fields.acceptance: A property test over generated logs (with change sets based on unlanded ones, retires and links to change sets) finds the new what-if equal to model.WhatIf over the full fold, model and problems both; read_test.go's stored-versus-what-if comparison still passes; BenchmarkShowWhatIf on the 50k model improves at least fivefold, recorded in the Evidence
fields.statement: A what-if read decodes only the in-flight change sets it needs and the landed ones their revisions name, over the index's stored as-is rows, instead of folding the whole log, and gives the same model and problems as the full fold
